visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a dimly lit indoor environment, resembling a camping-themed studio. A middle-aged man with short dark hair, wearing a grey long-sleeved outdoor shirt, sits behind a table. He holds a black, textured cylindrical flashlight in both hands, demonstrating it to the camera. On the table, several lighted vintage-style camping lanterns are placed, creating a warm, localized glow against the dark background. Yellow text overlays are visible at the top and bottom of the frame. (2) The camera transitions to a series of close-up shots focusing on the flashlight's physical attributes. The man's hands, with a watch on the left wrist, manipulate the device to show the diamond-patterned knurling on the aluminum alloy body. He demonstrates the magnetic charging base and a Type-C port transition. Later, he unscrews the bottom cap to reveal a large teal-colored rechargeable battery, holding it up for a clear view against the dark backdrop. (3) The setting shifts to an outdoor grassy field at night. The man, now shown in a full-body or medium-long shot, stands in the darkness holding the same flashlight. He places the light on the ground in 'tower lamp' mode, illuminating the immediate grass area. He then lifts it to eye level and switches to a high-intensity flashlight mode, projecting a powerful beam into the distance toward some trees. The lighting is dominated by the artificial beam of the flashlight cutting through the night sky.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio features a clear, centered male voice speaking Traditional Chinese at a steady conversational pace. The tone is informative and instructional. A soft, low-tempo acoustic-electronic BGM track plays continuously in the background, featuring gentle guitar plucks and a light rhythmic beat. The noise floor is very low, indicating a controlled indoor environment. (2) As the speaker demonstrates the product, distinct mechanical 'click' and 'snap' sounds occur as he presses buttons and manipulates the flashlight's parts. The voice maintains a consistent volume and pitch, occasionally rising slightly in intonation to emphasize specific features like the '5000 lumens' spec. (3) The acoustic texture subtly shifts as the scene moves outdoors. While the voice and BGM remain consistent, a very faint outdoor ambient noise floor (natural air movement) is detectable. The 'click' of the flashlight switch is prominent during the lighting tests. The overall mix is clean, with the voice clearly prioritized over the background music.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote and review the Olight Prowess flashlight by highlighting its dual-mode functionality (tower lamp and handheld flashlight). It provides detailed physical specifications and a practical night-time test to demonstrate its illumination power and versatility for camping activities.
